```yaml
name: NuGet Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - release
    tags:
      - '*'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [windows-latest, ubuntu-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Determine version
        id: determine_version
        run: |
          echo "VERSION=$(dotnet run --project build/Program.cs --determine-version)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update project version
        run: dotnet run --project build/Program.cs --update-version --version ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.VERSION }}

      - name: Build
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release

      - name: Test
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build

      - name: Push to NuGet
        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'
        env:
          NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NUGET_API_KEY }}
        run: dotnet run --project build/Program.cs --push-to-nuget
```
